issues.title: Bound the work of untrusted size arguments
issues.context: Where SciPy's algorithm is slow for huge arguments, Tessero runs the same algorithm: orthogonal polynomials with n around 1e9 loop n times, and anderson_ksamp, siegelslopes and percentileofscore are quadratic in the sample size. SciPy behaves the same, but a PHP web worker fed untrusted sizes can be tied up. Memory is already bounded: allocations sized by a parameter respect the budget, and RAM when no budget is set.

issues.title: Coverage inventory understates real coverage (shipped facade classes and Np methods untracked)
issues.context: The generated coverage page (docs/project/numpy-scipy-coverage.md, rendered live at the website /docs/coverage) reports about 60% FFI and 43% extension, far below real coverage. Two causes. First, tools/api-dump.php's class list omits five shipped FFI facade classes (ScipyLinalg, Distance, Signal, Ndimage, Csgraph), so they never reach api.json and their areas read 0%. Second, tools/gap_inventory.py's curated rows leave many shipped functions with empty references (Np vstack/split/tile/pad/outer/einsum/polyfit/interp/gradient/trapezoid/logspace/diag and more, Special logsumexp/polygamma/comb/factorial, Integrate Quad::quad, Spatial KDTree::query, Datetime), which render as not-available. No gate step verifies that the inventory references every shipped class: the generator only catches references to functions that do not exist, never shipped functions that have no reference, so the page drifts silently.
acceptance: api-dump.php dumps every generated facade class (ScipyLinalg, Distance, Signal, Ndimage, Csgraph)
gap_inventory.py rows and aliases reference all shipped functions; coverage.md regenerated
A gate check fails if any shipped facade class or public registry function is unreferenced by the inventory
The website /docs/coverage shows the corrected numbers

issues.title: Re-baseline the pinned fixture environment from SkylakeX (AVX-512) to Haswell (AVX2)
issues.context: The pinned reference environment (ADR 0012) forced OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=SkylakeX, an AVX-512 OpenBLAS kernel that is an illegal instruction on AVX2 hosts. The canonical fixture host is AVX2, so fixtures could not be regenerated there and adding any new function was blocked. Re-baselined to the Haswell OpenBLAS kernel, which runs on any AVX2+ CPU; single-threaded BLAS (OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1) keeps the summation order deterministic. Transcendental fixtures also shift about 1 ulp from the old host because of glibc/libm version differences, within the test tolerances.
acceptance: fixture_env.py and gen-fixtures.sh pin OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell; ADR 0012 updated
All fixtures regenerated on the canonical AVX2 host; full gate green on both backends
Fixture generation documented to require an AVX2+ host

issues.title: NumPy/SciPy gap-closure roadmap (tiered register with algorithms and PHP-ecosystem analysis)
issues.context: docs/project/numpy-scipy-gap-register.md enumerates every genuine remaining gap with the implementation algorithm, a portability verdict (including NumPy dtype/idiom features that do not map to a PHP numeric API), and whether the PHP ecosystem already covers it. Research finding: PHP has no implementation anywhere for all of scipy.signal, ODE solvers (solve_ivp/odeint), computational geometry (ConvexHull/Delaunay/Voronoi), scipy.ndimage array filters, the entire sparse ecosystem (formats, direct and iterative solvers, sparse eigensolvers), matrix functions (expm/logm/sqrtm), nonlinear and global optimization, Schur/QZ, NNLS, and N-D FFT. Tiers: 1 compose from shipped primitives; 2 real algorithm, no new dependency; 3 external C library (QHull/ARPACK/SuiteSparse/HiGHS) or heavy native; 4 not applicable to PHP. heaviside landed as the first Tier-1 item.
acceptance: Tier-1 batch implemented and verified on both backends (nd-FFT, ufunc fills, multivariate randoms, softmax/log_softmax/perm, simpson/cumulative_trapezoid, minimize_scalar, sparse diags, Polynomial)
Tier-2 and Tier-3 items tracked as sub-issues
The coverage page reflects each capability as it lands
